I cannot reproduce this error on master.

I get:

```
df1 = pd.DataFrame(
    {"col1": [pd.NA, "foo", "bar"]},
     index=["id1", "id2", "id3"], dtype=pd.StringDtype()
)
df2 = pd.DataFrame(
    {"id": ["id4", "id2", "id1"]}, dtype=pd.StringDtype()
)
df2["col1"] = df2["id"].map(df1["col1"])
print(df2.head())
    id  col1
0  id4  <NA>
1  id2   foo
2  id1  <NA>
```
If that is the case, then that is a good thing. I guess we have to wait until the next release then to have that fix available.
